verdict.rationale: The OCR 4.1 model page lists support for the /v1/batch endpoint, which suggests an asynchronous batch path for OCR. However, nothing describes per-job status polling or completion webhooks. Community reports describe the standard OCR call as synchronous, and one user hit a timeout on 900 pages and had to chunk manually, so the core OCR call can block. Missing for 10: documented async job submission for long parses, a job status polling endpoint, registrable completion webhooks, and hands-on corroboration of non-blocking batch OCR.

support.subject: As a developer, long parses run as async jobs with status polling and completion webhooks, so my pipeline never blocks
